# 105 Camps on the 5:00–6:00 sector — Black Rock City 2026

Camp placements are official Burning Man Project data and may be shown to users from Aug 23 12:01am (the dataset terms lift the camp-location embargo then; this release ships Aug 27). Playa Pal is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or verified by Burning Man Project.

## 3907

**Where:** 5:00 & A · **From:** Bishop, CA · **Landmark:** Smokey Bear Sign · **Year:** 2026

The beauty of Black Rock City is we are all on equal ground--in fact, we're 3,907 feet above sea level, and so are you! We are Elevators, here to Elevate your experience. Elevate yourself with our 12' tall Mood Swing! We will gladly supply you with (mis) information while you have a drink at the bar, then browse our clothing boutique for all the latest fashions. Be sure to join in our classes including make your own Rope Man, followed by a dive into our expanded pit of 1000 rubber chickens!

*More: https://www.facebook.com/camp3907*

## Afterglow Lounge & Spa

**Where:** 5:00 & B · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** Afterglow signage · **Year:** 2026

A communal space of nurturement where wandering burners can rejuvenate, relax and recharge. A caring place where burners can restore and reignite their radiant glow. Come to enjoy the spa, grab a drink and relax at the lounge, or get weird to the sound of our beats to show off that new sexy glow!

*More: https://www.instagram.com/burning.man.afterglow*

## Alchemy Stop

**Where:** 5:00 & F · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Pink and Yellow Flags and Limoncello Bar · **Year:** 2026

Alchemy Stop is a dusty sanctuary for anyone to enjoy a quiet musical retreat with a cold hand-made limoncello in hand. Look for our open bar - we will be welcoming you with open arms.

*More: https://www.alchemystop.org*

## Alice in Slumberland

**Where:** 5:30 & C · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** aluminet wall with a bar at the front · **Year:** 2026

The oldest Alice themed bar on the playa is back, but much less Alice-themed than you'd expect! Known for intricate cocktails and zany decor, this year the bar returns and it will be nastier than nasty. The extremely obvious speakeasy for a one time event, and we promise you won't believe what you will see behind the bar ! We offer our classic chill lounge with Tarot readings wednesday afternoon, you know what to expect for the rest of the week or for the rest of your life. Hungry and want to party all together ? Carbs meet chaos. We serve raviolis while DJs spin some tunes. Party with us until 23:00 fueled by pasta and playa magic on Wednesday.

## Anonymous Village

**Where:** 5:30 & F · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Marquee sign "Anonymous Village" · **Year:** 2026

Anonymous Village is a supportive community to help burners stay sober in the challenging environment of the playa and BRC. Members staff the Village hospitality tent and lead recovery meetings in communal meeting space. Recovery Yoga is available daily at 10:30am in the Yoga tent. We offer a daily meeting schedule including meetings of AA (Alcoholics Anonymous), NA (Narcotics Anonymous), Alanon, SAA/SLAA, FA/OA, CoDA, MA, and PIR. We also host sober camping as well as a separate area for Alanon's and recovery friends/allies. We also offer "AnyA" meetings daily that offer an inclusive environment for people recovering from addiction to "ANY" behavior or substance. We welcome curious burners who want to learn about how we burn sober.

*More: http://anonymousvillage.com*

## Argonauts

**Where:** B & 5:15 · **From:** Los Altos Hills · **Landmark:** Bow of our grounded wooden Argo ship and flags · **Year:** 2026

Cherish the uncertain, challenge fear, welcome the odd, and seek thyself! The Argonauts bring a unique and infectious spirit which we share across the playa and in conjunction with reenergizing camp activities including our high-noon ArgoDogs. Besides our Argonaut spirit and noontime hot dogs, our gifts include Argonaut dust, sun & fashion bandanas and spiritually-assigned individual Quests for each newly inducted Argonaut for the coming year.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/argonautsunited*

## As Above So At Camp

**Where:** D & 5:15 · **From:** Oakland, CA · **Landmark:** Camp flag with name · **Year:** 2026

We are the support camp for the Honoraria artwork As Above, So Within, a sculptural installation inspired by Persian mythology, mathematics, and fractal geometry. Our crew brings together artists, builders, designers, and fabricators supporting the piece from build through strike. The work explores the ancient idea that the patterns above us are reflected within us, using form, light, and computation. Come say hello, meet the team, and learn more about the artwork on playa.

## Atomic Pussy Photo Lounge

**Where:** B & 5:45 · **From:** Salt Lake City · **Landmark:** Camp Banner - Atomic Pussy Photo Lounge · **Year:** 2026

Come visit what is easily the 3rd best Bar/Lounge and Photo Booth on the playa. Returning this year is Weir(d) Wednesday, when we'll be serving up a hero dose of the Grateful Dead all afternoon. Also returning this year is our twin-tip, reverse camber Shot-Ski (for those playa face shots), the Elaine Benes Dance Experience (dance classes for dance-introverts) — and of course the photobooth, photo art, and photo gifts. Noon-6pm M-T-W-Th-F. Lounge space is 24 hrs.

*More: https://atomicpussyphotolounge.com*

## Avant Garden

**Where:** G & 5:45 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Neon Avant Garden sign, beige EMT structure · **Year:** 2026

We are a small Burning Man camp focused on creating community and connection both on and off Playa. We maintain a camp size of around 20 members, mostly based in the San Francisco/Bay Area. At night on Playa, our Brothel will serve hot, steamy broth to people who want a cozy place to hang out and warm up.

*More: https://avantgarden.camp/*

## Barbie Day Spa

**Where:** 5:30 & D · **From:** New York City · **Landmark:** Nail Spa Flags · **Year:** 2026

Get pampered at Barbie Day Spa: Fingernail painting, foot soaks, foot massage, body wash, erotic massage, cold drinks.

## Barbie Death Village

**Where:** 5:30 & C · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Hoard of 2000 Barbies · **Year:** 2026

Barbie Death Village is a delight to the eyes and the mind. Our camp features the Infamous Barbie Art - 1500 Barbies marching into the Barbie Dream Chipper. Barbie's street fronts are full of a range of interactivity! Swim up to our Barbie Swim Up Bar for a drink, enjoy our artistic Barbie-based silliness, stay for one of our many events which range from Pewter Casting, Liquid Light Show, Midnight Toast, Morning Mimosas (Sat), and so much more. Keep an eye out for and take a ride on our beloved Mutant Vehicle: The Barbie Whorehouse (It is not just a Whorehouse, it is a Whore Home.)

## Black Rock Academy

**Where:** C & 5:45 · **From:** Los Ángeles & Bay Area · **Landmark:** chalkboard that says "black rock academy" · **Year:** 2026

Black Rock Academy is a collective of artists and crafts-people. The collective works together to create art through different mediums year round through community engagement. We are often approached at Camp Black Rock Academy with the question of, "So what do you guys teach?" Personally, I dont think the important question is, "What do you guys teach?" But rather, I would follow up with, "What are you willing to learn?"

*More: https://www.instagram.com/camp.black.rock.academy/*

## BlinkingManCamp97

**Where:** C & 5:15 · **From:** Manhattan Beach · **Landmark:** GREEN LIGHTED IQ TEST SIGN OUT FROnT · **Year:** 2026

BlinkingManCamp97 blinks again where excess just never seems to be enough. We will have the usual art project on the trash fence - SK8Z, 50 skateboard decks decorated with past Bman themes. When in camp prove how smart you are by passing the wacky IQ Test and becoming a MENSA member, normal answers wont get you there! And of course we have a Dragnet Interrogation, our tradition since 1999. Remember while the others are thinking we'll be blinking . And we were among the very first burners to bring LERD lights to the playa!

*More: https://Blinkingmancamp.com*

## BLM/FNW Interpretive Camp

**Where:** Esplanade & 5:15 · **From:** Winnemucca · **Landmark:** BLM Interpretive Camp sign · **Year:** 2026

## BMIR

**Where:** Esplanade & 5:45 · **From:** Black Rock City · **Landmark:** Big radio tower that says BMIR in blinking lights! · **Year:** 2026

Burning Man Information Radio (94.5 FM) is your nexus for essential information on the playa. Check BMIR for late-breaking event announcements and a melange of music. In the event of an on-site emergency, tune into BMIR for rumor-free updates and advisories to surf the storm to a sane conclusion. Come down to BMIR from 12-5pm each day to record event and camp announcements. Or relate your encounters with radical acts of gifting on-air to the city at large.

*More: http://www.bmir.org*

## Brain Freeze Camp

**Where:** 5:00 & B · **From:** OAKLAND · **Landmark:** The Bar, Usually on corner, with a neon sign, · **Year:** 2026

We will be back again in 2026 serving the coldest frozen margaritas on the Playa. Our amusement center will certainly entertain you and Power to the People will be available to help keep your electrical devices charged.

## Bubble Camp

**Where:** 5:45 & G · **From:** London · **Landmark:** Geodesic dome with drippy lights · **Year:** 2026

Bubbles, bubbles everywhere and drops to drink for all. Dispensing thai iced tea and cold pressed coffee for all you parched playa peeps.

## Burning Sensation

**Where:** G & 5:45 · **From:** New York City · **Landmark:** metal flame sign with a dancing devil · **Year:** 2026

Through fiery flavors and spicy conversation, Burning Sensation awakens participants to the immediacy of the moment. At Fire Bar, guests are invited to sample gourmet hot sauces that challenge their resolve, while washing the heat down with bracing fireball cocktails. Rooted in inclusivity, we center BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ voices and bodies at our Playa Vybz party - while creating a space where all are invited to feel, engage, and burn brightly. Come experience hearts, tongues and souls on fire at Burning Sensation!

## Burning Sky

**Where:** 5:00 & F · **From:** Hawaii · **Landmark:** Burning Sky sign and wind indicating banner flags · **Year:** 2026

Skydivers over Burning Man. Come see Black Rock City from 9,000 feet in the air. Watch the skydivers exit the plane while you stay safely inside and get an exciting ride back to the earth. Gifting rides Wednesday & Thursday & Friday 11a-5p.

*More: https://burningsky.org*

## Camp ASL Support Services HUB

**Where:** G & 5:45 · **From:** Sonoma county · **Landmark:** "Valium" tagged on travel trailer · **Year:** 2026

American sign language Support services. Centralized services for the Deaf. Spanish speaking services provided as well. Come and flip a table. Come hang out by the fire pit after dark whenever it happens

## Camp Condundrum

**Where:** B & 5:15 · **From:** Berkeley · **Landmark:** LED water spout 20' above the ground · **Year:** 2026

Playa got you in a difficult place? Camp Conundrum might just be the answer. Our mutant vehicle, a delightful conundrum in itself, offers hydration, music to move you, and a pole for the ... adventurous.

## Camp Fortress of Solitude

**Where:** F & 5:15 · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Airstream traile, white Discovery motor home. · **Year:** 2026

Superman's Fortress of Solitude Art Car support camp.

## Camp Gotalotgoinon

**Where:** F & 5:15 · **From:** Sacramento · **Landmark:** Large camp sign and giant Teddy Bears · **Year:** 2026

A collective of doers and artist that want to create a collaborative art space to share with others. Creating together and experiencing multi-sensory art that inspires connection and growth. Come play games, solve a puzzle, get your dance on, add to the collaborative string art or come relax and take it all in at the tub. Whoever and whatever you create is art and we look forward to sharing ours with you and experiencing yours.

*More: http://www.upinsmokeflow.com/gotalotgoinon*

## Camp Kerosene

**Where:** B & 5:45 · **From:** Sacramento · **Landmark:** stripper pole bike trailer · **Year:** 2026

Black Rock City's premiere laser engraving camp. Solar powered gifts from the playa

*More: https://campkerosene.github.io/*

## Camp Nope

**Where:** B & 5:45 · **From:** Alameda · **Landmark:** The Camp Nope sign · **Year:** 2026

Visit Area 58, an intergalactic and interdimensional roadside attraction constructed from the wreckage of a time-bending rocket. Step inside and get transported. Find the hidden doorway to another dimension - but it only opens sometimes.

*More: http://www.dynope.com*

## Camp Orange

**Where:** 5:30 & B · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** 16' banana stand, giant hammock, orange dome · **Year:** 2026

Our 16-foot tall banana stand will once again tower erect over the Playa a shining, lighted beacon for all citizens of BRC in search of a place to rest their weary, dusty bananas! Join us for chocolate covered frozen bananas, fruity frozen drinks, silly dance parties, fun and educational sessions inside our cozy dome, a hang in the Largest Known Hammock, or just to chill out and have a good time.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/camporange_playaofficial/*

## Camp Shark Cage

**Where:** C & 5:45 · **From:** Sacramento, California · **Landmark:** Pyramid · **Year:** 2026

Welcome to the playa's one and only nautical Nicolas Cage theme camp! Come steal the Declaration of Independence with us.

*More: http://www.facebook.com/CampSharkCage*

## Camp Shit Ain't Right

**Where:** A & 5:45 · **From:** Pinedale · **Landmark:** Large painted canvases with our name on it. · **Year:** 2026

Wyoming-based with international flair - campmates from Wyoming, Canada, New Zealand, Russia, Australia, Ukraine, UK Germany, Netherlands... aaaand I'm definitely missing some. Come visit for public lounge, food, movie night, clothing boutique, large-scale, shitty punch and more!

## Camp Synthesis

**Where:** B & 5:45 · **From:** PDX · **Landmark:** Japan + Brazil flags, camp sign with name of camp · **Year:** 2026

Embodies the melding of three things: Synthesizers, Sake, and Sushi. Here's the concept: People who like producing music with synths, midi instruments, drum machines, etc., hanging out, jamming, teaching others to make music, performing live sets, share Japanese food, and sharing a drink. Daytime events: come jam on synths. Bring a synth or come play around with ours. Following the Food/Bar (takoyaki/soba) nights, we will host DJ sets from global random DJs who don't post their sets on social media. Come train human intelligence with us by generating analog signals.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/campsynthesis*

## Camp Tell You

**Where:** C & 5:45 · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** Tarot card art at our interactivity entrance · **Year:** 2026

A regenerative sanctuary on the playa. By day, we offer a regenerative sanctuary of healing frequencies. Mornings start with "Spill Tea over Tea," our daily conversation circle. Camp Tell You is a choice between surviving the playa and thriving within it, an invitation to explore interaction that goes beyond the ephemeral.

## Camp THREAT

**Where:** 5:30 & A · **From:** Portland OR · **Landmark:** Scaffold tower structure - red, black, and silver · **Year:** 2026

Dominating the portos for 6 years or more. Unofficial Headquarters of The Black Rock City Communist Party (BRCCP). Gonzo Decommodification Experts and Proud Purveyors of Bullshit. Sales and Service 100% Guaranteed to soothe the soul and waste the body and mind. Cold looks and warm seats. The whiskey is tolerable and the wine is worse. While supplies last. Conditions and terms apply. We are not a cult.

## Camp Truth or Dare

**Where:** C & 5:45 · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** !? Sign and Lit Up Tree · **Year:** 2026

Our mission is to inspire joy, mischief, courage, curiosity and connection through the game of "Truth or Dare," foster Burning Man's 10 Principles + consent, and promote the Radical Inclusivity, Diversity and Equity initiative.

## Chain Reaction

**Where:** A & 5:45 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Chain Reaction sign and flag · **Year:** 2026

Bike acting up out on playa? Pull up. We're a laid back bike repair camp helping people get rolling again from 11am to 6pm every day. Flats, loose chains, brakes acting weird, or just need air, we've got you. No appointments, no stress, just swing by. Need a break from the sun? Hang out for a bit, cool down, and kick it with us while we work. Good people, good energy, and a spot to reset before getting back out there.

*More: http://instgram.com/camp_chain_reaction?r=nametag*

## Champagne Lounge

**Where:** C & 5:45 · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Large wooden champagne bottle in front of camp · **Year:** 2026

Welcome to the Champagne Lounge! Amidst Black Rock City's hustle, our oasis offers luxurious relaxation. Step into our elegantly adorned shade, sip champagne poured by less than knowledgeable bartenders, and recline on plush playa-tech or mingle with fellow Burners. As the sun sets, enjoy twinkling lights and ambient music for a magical atmosphere. Cheers to the extraordinary!

*More: https://www.facebook.com/Champagnelounge/*

## Chicken Dragon

**Where:** D & 5:15 · **From:** Rochester, NY · **Landmark:** Castle with large Chicken Dragon Head · **Year:** 2026

Our camp is home to our mutant vehicle, Chicken Dragon - Hatchery Gone Wrong. Our hatchery has tried to obtain and hatch dragon eggs, but there have been issues, resulting in creatures that look a bit more like chickens. Visitors to our dungeon will see that we are hard at work trying to produce new dragons or chickens, we are not sure what we will get next. Our best hatchling grew large and protects our castle. His fire comes from his comb though, not his mouth. Nothing has gone quite right in the hatchery, but dancing in the dungeon and on the top of the castle will make up for our dragon-less frustration! Our vehicle will be available for exploring, dancing or possibly guest DJing when it is at camp or on the playa.

## CornHub

**Where:** 5:00 & A · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** Flag that looks eerily similar to the PornHub logo · **Year:** 2026

Do you love corn as much as we do? Come experience the entire gamut of the beautiful vegetable slash grain! Vegetables are a scarcity on the playa, so come join us for our fresh corn daily and build your own flavor popcorn bar to get your fibre on! Pooping is a problem out here, so make sure you get in and out of that little plastic box of a toilet as fast as possible. If you've got your fiber fix already, come hydrate with some iced beverages! After you're nourished and hydrated, climb up our 15' mushroom art piece and pop your head out the top for a view of the playa, if you dare!

*More: https://campcornhub.com*

## Desert Healers

**Where:** H & 5:45 · **From:** Walnut Creek · **Landmark:** Rumb shape gate with Desert Healers logo · **Year:** 2026

A welcoming sanctuary will provide a great refuge for those seeking to rest, meditate, decompress or rejuvenate. Experience Reiki Sessions with Desert Healers

## Dinosaur King

**Where:** C & 5:45 · **From:** California · **Landmark:** A large dinosaur · **Year:** 2026

Welcome to Dinosaur King, where prehistoric power meets the playa. Our camp is anchored by the Dinosaur King art car -- a full-body dinosaur skeleton mutant vehicle approximately 30 feet long and 12 feet tall, fabricated from steel and covered in thousands of programmable LEDs. A live DJ booth is built directly inside the skeleton's body cavity, where performers spin sets from within the belly of the beast. By day, the skeleton commands attention as a towering playa landmark. By night, it transforms into a blazing, glowing creature that pulses with music and light. The art car roams Black Rock City and returns to camp as an open dance floor for all Burners. No tickets, no guest list -- just good music, open space, and the freedom to move.

## Dusty Beavers

**Where:** F & 5:15 · **From:** Montreal · **Landmark:** Winter SnowMan · **Year:** 2026

We are the Dusty Beavers. We are a camp at Burning Man. We are from Québec, Canada and France. We bring love, joy and maple goodies to Burning Man!

*More: https://www.facebook.com/TheDustyBeavers*

## Dusty Dillas

**Where:** F & 5:15 · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Saloon doors & Dusty Dillas signs · **Year:** 2026

Experience the Wild Wild West at Dusty Dillas, a Western themed bar and quesadilla saloon. Here you'll find comfort in assless chaps, refreshing libations, and some cheesy goodness. Come on down for a dusty good time and a chance to spin the wheel to determine your luck in the dust.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/dusty_dillas/*

## Dusty Speakeasy and Sanctuary

**Where:** 5:00 & C · **From:** Reno, NV · **Landmark:** Dusty Speakeasy and Sanctuary sign · **Year:** 2026

Step into a 1920s Speakeasy...the legendary home of the dick whistle...mysteriously transported through time to the dusty playa. Sip on refreshing Bees Knees, whiskey & pickles, and other vintage cocktails while joining in the fun: Saloon Day, a Silent Disco, Dick Whistle Races, and don't forget to grab a cup of your own! Seeking a moment of reprieve? Find our Sanctuary, a cool oasis with hydration, light conversation, and a space to rest and recharge

## Earth Guardians

**Where:** Esplanade & 5:00 · **From:** Nevada City · **Landmark:** Earth Guardian Sign and EG man · **Year:** 2026

Earth Guardians are an outreach and communications volunteer group whose mission is to educate and inspire Burning Man participants to Leave No Trace (LNT) at the event. We can go beyond leaving "no trace" and leave instead, positive traces on the land. Come see our many bike nature and geology tours, sustainability speakers, DIY workshops, Aztec Burner dances, or volunteer training and gatherings! Come and volunteer on our LNT and compliance outreach teams or participate in a Gerlach LNT our hot-spring patrol, or jump on our MOOP train.

*More: http://earthguardians.net/*

## Enchanted Booty Forest

**Where:** 5:30 & B · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** Large Aluminet Shade Structure supported by Truss · **Year:** 2026

We love hearing that we're the most welcoming camp on playa, and we hear it a lot! We offer whatever our campers feel called to offer, so it's an eclectic mix of things including workshops, grilled cheese, dance parties, mini golf, and more. Come visit us, but be warned you might never want to leave...

## ESD Rampart

**Where:** Esplanade & 5:15 · **From:** New York City · **Landmark:** Look for the RED Cross on the Esplanade @ 5:15 · **Year:** 2026

Rampart is the main medical clinic staffed by licensed medical professionals able to provide advanced care to the entire community. Doctors, nurses, paramedics, x-ray techs, lab techs and pharmacists on staff 24/7 along with ambulances and aircraft provide care at the highest level under permit from the State of Nevada.

## FAFA Camp

**Where:** D & 5:15 · **From:** San Francisco Bay Area · **Landmark:** FAFA sign usually situated on truck facing road · **Year:** 2026

Welcome! We are an international camp and look forward to seeing you at our friendly, cozy camp. Come round mornings and afternoons for our interactivities or to just sit in the shade on our front porch.

## Fresh Squeezed!

**Where:** 5:00 & B · **From:** Austin · **Landmark:** Large LED Lemon · **Year:** 2026

Art & Lemonade since 2006. Come join us for ice cold lemonade and group painting.

*More: https://lemonade.art*

## Gigsville

**Where:** 5:00 & E · **From:** Los Angeles · **Landmark:** Large red G, Gigsville Sign, and a car on fire · **Year:** 2026

Gigsville embodies decades of Burning Man history, mixing a spirit of playful anarchy with a deep commitment to inclusion. Renowned for our legendary fuckery, we create a space where creativity and rebellion flourish. Here, every form of individuality is celebrated, from seasoned burners to wide-eyed newcomers. Our ethos is built on challenging norms and embracing everyone with a penchant for mischief and a heart for community. Expect the unexpected: from mind-bending installations to spontaneous performances, all wrapped in our trademark humor. Gigsville: where history, hijinks, and heartfelt acceptance collide around the Car-B-Q

## Gritty Garden

**Where:** B & 5:15 · **From:** Temecula · **Landmark:** Beige Shade Structure with the Gritty Garden sign · **Year:** 2026

Gritty Garden is a diversity driven camp offering a wide variety of workshops. Monday Craft Maker's Day, Heart-to-Heart hug workshop, the Joy of Cunnilingus, and How to Give Good NO. Sunday - Saturday refreshments Bar and ice cream.

*More: https://grittygarden.com/*

## Groundhaus

**Where:** 5:00 & E · **From:** los angeles · **Landmark:** Black Rock Goth Club signage on our stucture · **Year:** 2026

Groundhaus is a community camp featuring BRCGC spinning Industrial, EBM, Cold Wave, Dark Wave, Deathrock, Synthpop, RETRO, New Wave, and more.

## Habitat for Insanity

**Where:** 5:00 & D · **From:** Pittsburgh, PA · **Landmark:** Giant white igloo · **Year:** 2026

We create novel burner technology and use it to bring new experiences to Black Rock City. This includes shave ice machines invented by camp members, HVAC/refrigeration adaptations for our new installation "The Tundra," and geodesic dome design by one of the Burning Man old school masters.

## Hair of the Dog (HOTD)

**Where:** 5:30 & A · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Large orange letters in the sky: HOTD · **Year:** 2026

HOTD (Hair Of The Dog) is the longest running bar at Burning Man. We hold a piece of the original fire. HOTD gives raw performances and spontaneous acts and entertainment powered by you! HOTD is a donation bar ran on participation and gifts by burners like you! If you bring the booze and the music, then we supply the music and the booze!

*More: https://thehotd.com*

## Healing Foot Wash Life Truth Love

**Where:** 5:00 & G · **From:** Benicia · **Landmark:** silver shade structure, blue banner, flag w/ feet · **Year:** 2026

Life, Truth, Love: Come sit under our cooling shade canopy and get your feet washed, dried and moisturized in a tranquil and calming environment. After you have received this gift, you are invited to participate as well. We are actively building world peace and community.

*More: https://healingfootwash.org*

## HIGHKU

**Where:** C & 5:45 · **From:** Oakland, CA · **Landmark:** Large wooden torii gate with Camp HIGHKU sign. · **Year:** 2026

Push through our glowing torii gate and drop into a solar-fueled zen oasis humming on pure sun power; no roar of generators, just clean, quiet relief. Mist-kissed shade with rippling silk skies and angled tarps welcomes you to endless icy lemonade, coconut water, and a gentle train that chugs surprise gifts...cooling bandanas, glow bits, playa vitamins; straight to your dusty lap. Sink into the vibe with smooth beats, soft programmable LED dreams at night, and spontaneous serotonin sparks through flow, chats, and soul-deep workshops. This is your midday (and midnight) haven to exhale, recharge, laugh, and remember why we come to the dust. Come find your glow, we are waiting.

## Hippocampus

**Where:** 5:00 & F · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Giant Seahorses entry gate to shade area · **Year:** 2026

Dust off your goggles and follow the scent of sizzle to Hippocampus, where the griddle is hot and the coffee is bottomless! We're serving up fluffy flapjacks and radical connections to fuel your morning art adventures, so bring a plate and leave with a new playa family. Once the sun climbs high, return for Liquid Courage Karaoke to gift your wildest, dust-filtered vocals to the desert sky. Whether you're flipping cakes or belting out anthems, your participation is the magic that makes this camp come alive. Join us in the dust - where the syrup flows as freely as the songs!

## Holy Babel

**Where:** C & 5:15 · **From:** Atlanta · **Landmark:** Large White Big Top Tent in the middle of camp. · **Year:** 2026

The Art of Such n Such is returning to BRC. This time, we are an art support camp, led by Charlie Blackcat Smith who will be working on a collaborative. fire based art piece that will serve as a memorial for Brian Doherty who met a fast fate in March. Brian literally wrote the book on Burning Man titled "This is Burning Man" in 2004. This will be a small camp centered on erecting and managing the memorial art piece and keeping it safe and running during the event. In previous years, this camp has also been known as A.S.S. Camp. Come and find a bunch of crusty Burners here.

## Hookers & Peggers Naughty Cafe

**Where:** C & 5:15 · **From:** San Jose · **Landmark:** 10' tall purple ring & hook game w lit disco ball · **Year:** 2026

Come for the coffee and stay for the fun! Test your skill on our 10' Hooker & Pegger game, or launch a dildo to drench your buddy in our dunk tank! Don't forget to take a complimentary porno mag while you're at it.

## ICU: Impromptu Crafters Union

**Where:** B & 5:45 · **From:** Atlanta · **Landmark:** Inconvenience Store and Shed with rooftop deck · **Year:** 2026

Suffering from crafter withdrawal? Visit the ICU for a daily dose of creativity in the shade, cuz making Art cures what ails ya! Craft offerings change daily.

## Impromptu Tomato

**Where:** C & 5:15 · **From:** Seattle · **Landmark:** Tomato Dome, lit at Night · **Year:** 2026

Your neighborhood coffeeshop serving The Playa's Most Adequate Coffee every morning. Bring your cup. Milks, sugars, light snacks, shade, and good conversation provided. Find us by the giant tomato - our gently cooled and ventilated chill space.

*More: https://youtu.be/w0RNr7hjcgk?si=lSf6K-lZnLLUcC1z*

## Iron Monkeys

**Where:** C & 5:15 · **From:** Seattle · **Landmark:** the Iron Monkey Logo sign · **Year:** 2026

Home to the Iron Monkeys
